subject: Charged twice
body: I was charged twice for the annual plan today. My card is now over its limit and payroll runs tomorrow. Please refund one charge.

subject: Invoice copy
body: Could you send me a PDF copy of the March invoice? Our accountant needs it for the yearly report.

subject: VAT number on invoice
body: Please add our VAT number DE123456789 to future invoices. Nothing urgent.

subject: Payment failed, service suspended
body: Our payment failed and the workspace was suspended. 40 people cannot work right now. We updated the card, please reactivate.

subject: Refund for unused seats
body: We removed 5 seats last month but still paid for them. Can we get a refund or credit for the difference?

subject: Switch to yearly billing
body: How much would we save if we move from monthly to yearly billing?

subject: Wrong amount charged before audit
body: You charged us $4,900 instead of $490. Our finance audit closes at 5 pm today and this charge must be reversed before then.

subject: Receipt email address
body: Receipts go to my old email. Where can I change the billing contact?

subject: Why did the price go up?
body: This month's invoice is 15% higher than last month. I did not change the plan. What happened? Honestly this is really annoying.

subject: Discount for non-profit
body: We are a registered charity. Do you offer any discount for non-profits?

subject: Card charged after cancellation
body: I cancelled last week, but you charged my card again this morning and now I can't pay my rent due today. Refund it now.

subject: Currency of invoices
body: Is it possible to be billed in EUR instead of USD?

subject: Duplicate invoice numbers
body: Two invoices from you have the same number INV-2231. Could you check and reissue one of them?

subject: Trial converted, charged by mistake
body: My trial turned into a paid plan and charged $1,200 to the company card. The card gets blocked if not refunded by tomorrow.

subject: Payment methods
body: Do you accept bank transfer or only credit cards?

subject: Upgrade cost mid-cycle
body: If I upgrade from Basic to Pro in the middle of the month, how is the price calculated?

subject: Old invoices
body: Where can I download invoices from 2024? The billing page shows only the last 12 months.

subject: Double subscription
body: We somehow have two active subscriptions and were billed for both. Our budget for the quarter is blown and the CFO wants this fixed today.

subject: Tax exemption certificate
body: We have a sales tax exemption certificate. How do we submit it so that tax is not added?

subject: Coupon did not apply
body: I entered the code SPRING20 at checkout but the price stayed the same. Can you apply it retroactively?

subject: Cancel subscription
body: Please cancel our subscription at the end of the current period. We are moving to another tool.

subject: Refund needed for chargeback deadline
body: My bank says I must resolve the duplicate charge with you by end of day or the chargeback window closes. Please refund order #88213.

subject: Billing cycle date
body: Can I change the billing date from the 3rd to the 1st of each month?

subject: Price for 200 seats
body: We are planning to grow to 200 users next year. Is there volume pricing?

subject: Overcharged again!!!
body: Third time this year you overcharged us by a few dollars. I am tired of checking every invoice. Please fix your billing.

subject: Invoice blocking payment run
body: Our supplier payment run starts in two hours and your invoice has the wrong company name, so finance will reject it. Please reissue it right away.

subject: Proforma invoice
body: Our procurement team needs a proforma invoice before they can approve the purchase.

subject: Refund status
body: I requested a refund 10 days ago. Any update?

subject: Student pricing
body: Is there a student price for the Pro plan?

subject: Account locked for unpaid invoice
body: The account got locked over an invoice we already paid by wire. Our support team is offline and customers are waiting. Here is the transfer confirmation.

subject: API returns 500
body: Our integration started returning 500 errors on every request 20 minutes ago. We can't process any customer orders until this is fixed.

subject: Typo in docs
body: There is a typo in the API docs: 'recieve' in the webhooks section.

subject: Data export broken before deadline
body: CSV export fails with a timeout. We must submit this data to the regulator by noon tomorrow.

subject: Slow dashboard
body: The dashboard takes about 8 seconds to load in the mornings. Not critical, but annoying.

subject: Webhooks stopped
body: Webhooks stopped arriving an hour ago. Our checkout depends on them and orders are piling up unpaid.

subject: Dark mode glitch
body: In dark mode the chart legend text is almost invisible.

subject: SDK version question
body: Which Python versions does your SDK support?

subject: Production down after update
body: After your update this morning our production app crashes on startup with 'invalid token format'. All our users are affected.

subject: Rate limit question
body: What is the rate limit for the search endpoint? We want to plan a batch job next month.

subject: Mobile app crash on old phone
body: The mobile app crashes when I open settings on my old Android 9 phone. Other screens work.

subject: Sync deletes records
body: Since yesterday the sync is deleting records from our CRM. We have already lost 300 contacts and it keeps going.

subject: Feature flag not working
body: The beta flag for the new editor does not seem to do anything for my account.

subject: Timezone wrong in reports
body: Weekly reports show times in UTC instead of our local time.

subject: Payments page blank
body: Our customers see a blank payments page since 10:00. We are losing sales every minute. Please help!

subject: Error message unclear
body: When an upload fails the app just says 'Error 17'. Could the message be more helpful?

subject: This bug is driving me crazy
body: For two weeks the search ignores the date filter. I reported it before. Fix it already, it's ridiculous.

subject: SSL certificate expired
body: Our custom domain shows an expired certificate warning and customers can't open the portal at all.

subject: Import from Excel
body: Does the import support .xlsx files or only CSV?

subject: Broken link in email
body: The 'view in browser' link in your newsletter leads to a 404 page.

subject: Database migration stuck
body: The migration tool is stuck at 60% for 3 hours and our store has been in maintenance mode the whole time.

subject: API pagination
body: How do I get more than 100 results from the list endpoint? Is there pagination?

subject: Chrome extension slow
body: Your Chrome extension makes Gmail noticeably slower.

subject: Login API outage for our app
body: Your auth API returns 503 and none of our users can sign in to our app. Launch event is in one hour.

subject: Memory usage
body: The desktop app uses 2 GB of RAM after a day of work. Is that expected?

subject: Integration with Slack
body: Notifications to Slack stopped including the ticket title. Small thing but please check.

subject: Duplicate emails to customers
body: Your system is sending every notification to our customers 5 times. People are complaining and threatening to cancel.

subject: Docs for webhooks signature
body: Where can I find how to verify the webhook signature?

subject: Print layout
body: When I print an invoice from the app the logo is cut off.

subject: Search returns old data
body: After editing a product, search still shows the old name for a few minutes.

subject: Reports empty before board meeting
body: All reports are empty since last night. The board meeting starts at 9 am and I need these numbers.

subject: Locked out before demo
body: I can't log in: the password reset email never arrives, and I have a demo for investors in one hour.

subject: Change email
body: How do I change the email address on my account? No rush, just curious.

subject: Delete my account
body: Please delete my account and all my personal data.

subject: Account hacked
body: Someone changed my password and email. I see logins from another country. Please lock the account now.

subject: Add a teammate
body: How can I invite a colleague to our workspace?

subject: Two-factor setup
body: I want to enable two-factor authentication. Which apps are supported?

subject: Admin left the company
body: Our only admin left yesterday and nobody can manage the workspace. New employees start today and need access.

subject: Rename workspace
body: Can we rename our workspace from 'Test' to our company name?

subject: Profile photo
body: My profile photo upload keeps failing. Is there a size limit?

subject: Merge two accounts
body: I accidentally created two accounts with different emails. Can they be merged?

subject: 2FA phone lost
body: I lost my phone with the 2FA app and I am locked out. I need to send contracts from the account today.

subject: Change username
body: Is it possible to change my username?

subject: Transfer ownership
body: I'm leaving the team next month. How do I transfer ownership of the workspace to my colleague?

subject: SSO question
body: Do you support SAML single sign-on on the Business plan?

subject: Employee still has access
body: We fired an employee an hour ago and he still has access to client data. Remove him immediately.

subject: Language settings
body: How do I switch the interface to German?

subject: Notification settings
body: I get too many emails from you. Where can I turn some of them off?

subject: You keep logging me out
body: Every day the app logs me out and I have to type my password again. This is very irritating.

subject: Wrong person got admin rights
body: We gave admin rights to the wrong person by mistake and they started deleting projects. Please revoke it now.

subject: Account verification
body: I didn't get the verification email after sign-up. Can you resend it?

subject: Export my data
body: I'd like to download all data related to my account for my records.

subject: Change company name
body: Our company was renamed. How do we update the organization name in the account?

subject: Locked after failed attempts
body: The account locked after failed logins. I'm the only one who can approve today's payroll and it must go out by 3 pm.

subject: Guest access
body: Can I give a client read-only access to one project?

subject: Password rules
body: What are the password requirements? My new password keeps being rejected.

subject: Close duplicate workspace
body: We have an empty duplicate workspace. Please remove it.

subject: Suspicious login alerts
body: I got 10 alerts about logins from unknown devices in the last 10 minutes. I think someone is in my account right now.

subject: Change phone number
body: How can I update the phone number used for account recovery?

subject: Role permissions
body: What is the difference between Editor and Manager roles?

subject: Session timeout
body: Can admins set a shorter session timeout for all users?

subject: Dark theme?
body: Hi! Do you have a dark theme for the dashboard? It would be a nice feature to have.

subject: Thank you
body: Just wanted to say your support team was great last week. Thanks!

subject: Feature request: calendar view
body: It would be great to have a calendar view for tasks.

subject: Partnership
body: We are an agency and would like to become a reseller. Who should we talk to?

subject: Roadmap question
body: Are you planning an offline mode this year?

subject: Webinar recording
body: Where can I find the recording of yesterday's webinar?

subject: Job application
body: Are you hiring support engineers in Berlin?

subject: Press inquiry with deadline
body: I'm a journalist writing about your outage. I need a comment from your team within the next hour before publication.

subject: Survey feedback
body: Your NPS survey has a broken scale on mobile, just letting you know.

subject: Case study
body: We'd be happy to be featured in a case study. Interested?

subject: Your product is terrible
body: I hate the new design. Everything moved and nothing makes sense. Bring back the old one!

subject: Conference sponsorship
body: Would you like to sponsor our developer conference in May?

subject: Training materials
body: Do you have training videos for new employees?

subject: Legal notice
body: We received a court order requiring data preservation for case 24-117 starting today. Please confirm who handles legal requests.

subject: API for education
body: Is there a sandbox we can use in a university course?

subject: Accessibility
body: Does your app support screen readers? We have a blind colleague joining.

subject: Suggestion for keyboard shortcuts
body: Please add a shortcut to archive items. I use it a lot.

subject: Security questionnaire
body: Our security team needs your SOC 2 report for vendor review next quarter.

subject: Integration idea
body: Any plans to integrate with Notion?

subject: Office address
body: What is your office address for sending documents?

subject: Security vulnerability report
body: I found a way to read other customers' files through your public share links. It is being exploited right now; who is your security contact?

subject: Merch
body: Do you sell branded t-shirts? Our team loves your product.

subject: Compliance question
body: Is your data stored in the EU?

subject: Beta program
body: How can I join the beta testing program?

subject: Community forum
body: Is there a community forum where users share templates?

subject: Testimonial
body: Your tool saved us hours every week. Feel free to quote me.

subject: Holiday hours
body: Will support be available during the holidays?

subject: Media outage live
body: A TV crew is filming a live segment about our store in 30 minutes and we need to know if your platform outage will be over by then.

subject: Referral program
body: Do you have a referral program?

subject: Template request
body: Could you add a template for weekly team retrospectives?
